messages:
maya (product): Dropping the follow-up thread for pricing/usage q's from the all-hands. Keep them short and we'll answer during office hours.
owen (eng): Quick one: can clients rely on both route-level and account-level headers for backoff logic?
owen (eng): Example headers we're returning: `X-RateLimit-Route`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`, and `Retry-After` on 429s.
sam (finance): If a trial runs out mid-run, are customers charged automatically?
maya (product): No auto-charge. We surface a billing modal and pause new requests; in-flight requests finish when possible.
lia (customer success): Customers ask how the "burst" add-on is priced for Dedicated. Is it hourly, or flat per-event?
sam (finance): Burst pricing is configurable: hourly for ad-hoc bursts, discounted flat blocks for pre-purchased burst credits. We publish the standard hourly rates in the enterprise SOW.
nina (ops): Ops detail: we can enable an org-level grace window (short) to prevent immediate cutoffs during credit depletion. This is opt-in per account.
maya (product): How long is the grace window by default?
nina (ops): Default soft-grace is 3-7 minutes depending on traffic pattern; ops can extend if capacity allows.
lia (customer success): For private/on-prem evals, are there any hosted credit hooks we should warn customers about?
sam (finance): Hosted credits don't apply to self-managed Private. If Redwood manages the infra under a trial, we can apply credits — that'll be explicit in the POC terms.
owen (eng): What happens to long-running streaming sessions when credits expire? Do we cut stream instantly?
nina (ops): We try to cut at safe checkpoint boundaries. For streaming we send a final 200 with an explanation footer where possible; otherwise we send a terminal 402/429 depending on context.
billing-bot: Billing notice: "Org: greenfield-co, Trial credit 10% remaining" sent to billing@greenfield.co
maya (product): Refund policy in short: case-by-case, typically first-time mistakes get credits; fraud/abuse handled via account review.
sam (finance): SLA: we aim to respond to billing disputes within 3 business days, resolution target 10 days. Exceptions for enterprise are handled in contract.
owen (eng): One operational note: we added `X-Credit-Remaining` header to help SDKs display accurate UI. Please use that instead of parsing usage from logs.
lia (customer success): Can we proactively notify customers before a costly burst occurs? e.g., "you will exceed $X if current jobs continue"
sam (finance): Yes, we have an alerting rule that can email an org admin at 50%, 80%, and 95% consumption. It's on by default for trials.
maya (product): Thanks. If anyone needs a formal RFC or a follow-up ticket, react with :eyes: and I'll file it.
